definitions.explanation: A condition that impairs normal physical or mental functions. Can range from minor to serious.

notes:
{病気|びょうき} refers to illness or disease, covering both minor and serious conditions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {病気|びょうき}になる: to get sick
- {病気|びょうき}が{治|なお}る: to recover from illness
- {病気|びょうき}で{休|やす}む: to be absent due to illness

CONTRAST WITH けが:
- {病気|びょうき}: illness (internal causes)
- けが: injury (external causes)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {病院|びょういん}: hospital
- {病人|びょうにん}: sick person
- {入院|にゅういん}: hospitalization
- {通院|つういん}: outpatient visits
